Instructions for Completing a Payroll Services Delegation of Authority Form


Effective DateComplete the date the document goes into effect.

Agency/Unit Complete "242"/and the three (3) digit reporting unit number used to identify where the paychecks for this area should be distributed. There are multiple fields that
should be completed if the Division has multiple reporting unit numbers that will be monitored by the appropriate administrator signing this document.

Division Select the appropriate Division (e.g. Academic Affairs.)

Dept/Dept IDComplete the Department name (e.g. Faculty Affairs & Records) and the Department ID number (e.g. 1XXXX.)

CollegeSelect the appropriate College (e.g. College of Business and Economics) if applicable.

Faculty/Staff AttendanceIn this section you will add and/or delete the primary and alternate Faculty, Administrator and Staff Timekeeper(s) for the reporting unit(s) listed on this document.
Please remember that as you add to these roles you may need to delete accordingly. You may do so on the same sheet.

TimekeeperComplete the printed name(s) of the Timekeeper(s) being added and/or deleted for the unit(s) you've listed in the section identified for the action you are updating.
Note the message in red.

Approving OfficialComplete the printed name and signature of the Approving Official being added and/or deleted for the unit(s) you've listed in the section identified for the action you
are updating. The Approving Official has the authority to sign the following documents; Attendance Forms - Absence and Additional Time Worked Report
(form 634), Authorization for Extra Hours, Hourly/Intermittent Timesheets, Dock Forms and miscellaneous PR docs in the section identified.
This delegate must be an MPP or equivalent.

Certification ReportComplete the printed name and signature of the Approving Official being added and/or deleted for the unit(s) you've listed in the section identified for the action you
are updating. The Approving Official has the authority to sign Attendance Certification Reports.This delegate must be an MPP or equivalent.

Student AttendanceIn this section you will add and/or delete the primary and alternate student Timekeeper(s) for the reporting unit(s) listed on this document. Please remember that
as you add to these roles you may need to delete accordingly. You may do so on the same sheet.

TimekeeperComplete the name(s) of the Timekeeper(s) being added and/or deleted in the section identified for the action you are updating. Note the message in red.

Student Time SheetComplete the printed name and signature of the supervisor authorized to approve student schedules and attendance documents that are being added and/or
deleted in the section identified for the action you are updating.

Approving Official CD-048Complete the printed name and signature of the Approving Official for the reporting unit(s) listed in the section identified for the action you are updating.
This delegate must be an MPP or equivalent.

WARRANT COORDINATORComplete the printed name(s) and signature(s) of the Warrant Coordinator(s) that are being added and/or deleted in the section identified for the action you are
updating. Warrant Coordinators are authorized to pick up warrants for the unit(s) listed. Note the message in red.

CMS Student Confirmation TicketsComplete the printed name(s) and signature(s) of the Approving Official for the reporting unit(s) listed in the section identified for the action you
Primary/Alternateare updating. Please remember that as you add to these roles you may need to delete accordingly. You may do so on the same sheet.
This delegate must be an MPP or equivalent.

APPROVALSComplete the printed names and signatures of the Department Head, College Dean, and Division Head or designee for the reporting unit(s) listed granting
signature authority to those stated on this document.
